title: Wall Mount for String Trimmer – Heavy-Duty Tool Holder
descriptionHtml:
Get your garden tools in order

Trimmers, garden tools and hand tools leaning against the wall easily fall over and take up space. In the garage it quickly gets messy.

Heavy-duty metal brackets

These metal wall brackets hold your string trimmer and other tools securely in place. They're easy to mount and make the garage both tidier and easier to work in.

Features

  • Heavy-duty metal wall brackets
  • Keep trimmer and tools in place
  • Easy to mount
  • Creates order in the garage
  • Fits most string trimmers and tools

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
